run_upload_gmock: run upload_gmock.py to upload a Google Mock patch with the gmock group auto-cc'd
run_main_function: run the main function to invoke upload.py with modified command line flags
review_main_function: review the main function that wraps upload.py and adds the Google Mock mailing list to cc
refactor_main_function: refactor the main function to support additional cc recipients beyond the gmock group
summarize_upload_gmock: summarize the upload_gmock.py wrapper script that passes flags to upload.py with auto cc
